The '''All Terrain Exploration Transport (AT-ET)''', most commonly known as the "'''Strider'''", was a six-legged [[Walker/Legends|walker]] designed by [[Rothana Heavy Engineering/Legends|Rothana Heavy Engineering]] for exploration. It was a smaller variant of the [[All Terrain Exploration and Survey Walker|AT-EST exploration walker]].<ref name="SS" />
